recipes.name: Quick and Easy Clam Chowder
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of celery soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of potato soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can New England clam chowder

steps.text: Mix cream of celery soup, cream of potato soup, clam chowder, 1 can undrained clams, 1 can drained clams, half-and-half cream, and whipping cream into a slow cooker.
Cover, and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Quick and Easy Clam Chowder
raw_recipe.description: The best ever clam chowder you have ever tasted, and it is easy and fast. You will pass this recipe along to your family and friends. If you like more clams you can always add more. Sometimes I will also cube potatoes and throw them in.

review.reviewBody: I am the original poster of this recipe and since posting this I, too, have made some changes to thicken the soup up. I now 2 to 3 cans of New England Clam Chowder and 2 to 3 cans of Cream of Potato soup. I also add 4 cans of the minced clams. This is still the best Clam Chowder I have ever tasted!!!! Enjoy!!!!

Loved this! It was plenty thick and creamy with good flavor. I kicked it up a notch by adding 4 cubed unpeeled red potatoes, 3 chopped celery sticks and 1/2 an onion, all of which I sautee'd in butter till the potatoes softened just a bit. Great for a fall football watch party!

I made this tonight and it was delicious! My boyfriend is from Boston and I am a Florida girl. I was nervous about making him clam chowder especially from so many cans of condensed soup, but he was truly impressed he kept praising me for making an authentic New England clam chowder! I used two cans cream of potato, two cans clam chowder and one can cream of celery all condensed Campbell’s. I used the suggested amount of heavy whipping cream but cut the half and half to two cups and so glad I did or it would have been too thin. I sautéed celery and onion and threw that in with three red potatoes I had peeled, diced small and cooked until mostly soft in the microwave. Personal preference I only used two cans undrained clams. I put a tad bit of thyme, salt, pepper and garlic powder. My boyfriend was truly impressed by my New England style clam chowder and my 16 year old son who eats clam chowder in restaurants frequently said mom that’s one of the best clam chowders I’ve ever had can you make it again? So don’t hesitate to try this version of clam chowder I think you will be very pleased with the results!

This was very good and easy to make. I did it on the stove and let it simmer for 45mins. I also added chopped carrots and potatoes and sautéed a chopped onion in 3 tbsp of butter and added a little white wine and fresh cracked pepper.

For my first time making this soup, one thing I did differently was add less cream than called for. I used about 2/3 the quart, simply because I didn't want it any thinner than it was at that point. I also sauteed a small onion and minced garlic (because I add garlic to almost everything) in about 1/4 cup of butter which I then added to the soup. And, for the can of clam chowder, I used Progresso to get a little more heartiness into the soup.
It was delicious and I loved it! Also love how simple and quick this was.
Next time I make this, I'll add 2 more cans of clams. Other than that, perfect!

I will never make another clam chowder. This is, hands down, the simplest, best-tasting chowder I've ever made, and it sure beats the over-thick glop you too frequently get at restaurants. This is thick but not too thick, creamy, fragrant, and all over just wonderful. I followed KRISSTINA's advice. Yes, you purists, I altered the recipe to suit me, but the basics are the same. Like Krisstina I added 2 small, diced potatoes, a teaspoon of cumin, and a little bit of onion, about 2 tablespoons of dehydrated onion flakes, which equals about 1/4 cup chopped fresh onion. Threw a stalk of celery in the food processor and chopped it fine and added that too. Based on all the other reviews, I increased the clams to three 10.75 oz cans of whole clams. I drained only two of the cans--that little bit of clam juice from the third can adds desirable flavor. The texture, flavor, creaminess, and fragrance of this chowder cannot be beat. I know I will make it again and again. Thank you to the person who posted this! Oh yes, I assembled it on a Sunday night and put it on low on the slow cooker next morning for 9 hours before leaving for work. It was ready when I walked in the door and it was perfectly blended and cooked.
To thicken it, add 1/3 c instant potato flakes. I think adding more of the clams might be better. 3-4 cans. Doing it w all heavy cream is decadent. Skip the half and half.

I made this soup two nights ago with just some minor changes after reading ALL the previous reviews. I used 1 can of cream of celery, 2 cans of cream of potato and 2 cans of clam chowder (all condensed Campbell's). I peeled and cut up 2 potatos and nuked them for a couple of minutes. I added them into the soup along with the full quart of half/half and heavy cream. I used 4 cans of minced clams (2 drained, 2 not) I added pepper, garlic powder, onion powder (only because I didn't have an onion to add into the soup). I cooked it in my crock pot for about 8 hrs on low temp. The last hour I removed the cover to help thicken. This was not watery at all and the flavor blends were amazing. My husband said it was the best clam chowder I have ever made, and I have made quite a few (even from scratch). I took some to my neighbor who isn't a huge clam chowder person, but he said it was the best he had ever had. This recipe will definitely be in my rotation during winter soup season! Thanks Deena for submitting!
I have been making this every Thanksgiving for at least 6 years! I add more clams ,chopped bacon and two stalks of celery (remove before serving) My family and friends cant get enough of it

I added 2 medium diced potatoes, 2 stalks of diced celery, 4 diced baby carrots, 1 small onion diced.. sauteed in 1 tbsp. Bacon grease. Also added a dash of red wine vinegar and a dash of bay seasoning. Garnished with chives, and served with fresh sourdough bread. Excellent!

I have been making this recipe for years with the addition of onions and celery sauteed in butter and sometimes a little bacon as well and have become famous in my family for it. I make it in the morning or the day before and get rid of all the cans - no one knows my "secret recipe" hahaha. I've made it on the stovetop and the slow cooker - better in the slowcooker if you have the time.
Keeper

I used 2 cans of each soup and could not find cream of potato soup I used potato bacon soup. I did not have half and half but did have heavy whipping cream. The chowder turned out great and my husband loved it! Will be making again.
My husband loves it! I also have a question. Since Campbell's no longer make and sell condensed New England clam chowder, can anyone recommend a good substitute to use for this recipe? Thank you!

Not to state the obvious but why use canned potato, celery soups, and actual clam chowder to make clam chowder? Clam chowder is simple without the added sodium, fat and artificial additives. Use fresh potatoes, fresh celery, clam juice and chopped clams. Milk and a little heavy cream makes it creamy.

I was dubious about using soup as a base, but it came out GREAT.CHANGES I made:(2) cans of the clam chowderAdded: canned oysters (about 6 oz) medium size shrimp (about 1 pound) Celery (1 cup diced small) Carrots (1/2 cup, diced small) 2# of diced potatoes I bet mushrooms might be good too.
I love this recipe only I use 4 cans whole clams. As suggested, I use whipping cream and a stick of butter. It is easy and delicious. Thank you Deena!

This is a very nice recipe that I adjusted a bit. 3 cans Snows condensed clam chowder 3 cans cream of celery 3 cans cream of potato 2 lbs fresh minced clams Pint of half and half Pint of heavy cream Salt, pepper, Old Bay Seasoning to taste Comes out thick, with clams in every bite. My crew really enjoys this.

The modifications I made according to Deena and the rest of you very helpful cooks are in the slow cooker now!
The only mistake is a missing ingredient ~ full fat half & half !
My best friend was grabbing ingredients off shelves and unfortunately, pulled FAT FREE HALF AND HALF QUART... YUCK. BUT ...hopefully by morning, on slow all night, the taste and texture works. 
I added some Irish butter to add fat and flavor. 
Fingers crossed. 
Did the sherry, and a pinch of cinnamon, pinch of cumin. 
No old bay on hand.
Potatoes and sautéed onions to start.
Thank you Deena!
I'm praying for thick and yummy by morning!
3 cans cream Potato soup 
3 cans cream celery soup
2 larger cans new England clam chowder 
4 cans chopped clams, and juice 
Plus sherry wine
Amd some bottled clam juice 
All on low/slow , overnight. 
Update tomorrow!
When serving add a sprinkling of chopped parsley and chives. I love this with oyster crackers
